speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain that radiates down your leg. To better understand your condition, could you describe the exact path where you feel this pain traveling?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Sciatica (likely L5 or S1 radiculopathy) secondary to acute muscle strain or herniated disc. The history of sudden onset during exercise with pain radiating to the foot is classic for sciatic nerve involvement. I recommend ordering an MRI of the lumbar spine to rule out a significant disc herniation compressing the nerve root. REQUEST IMAGES: Lumbar_MRI
